title: SEO Copywriter (Health & Wellness)
subtitle: About PATI Group
body:
## **About PATI Group**

PATI is a fast-growing E-commerce business specializing in dietary supplements, achieving a remarkable 500% increase in sales within just one year in the United States market.

We're on a mission to become the leading dietary supplement company in Vietnam by 2026, offering innovative and high-quality products that inspire our customers to optimize their physical, mental, and intellectual potential.

To get there, we are hiring an **SEO Copywriter – Health & Wellness (English required)** who can turn evidence-based insights into engaging articles, landing pages, and micro-copy that rank — and convert.

## **Job Summary**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and creative **SEO Copywriter**, who will be responsible for **building the foundational knowledge base** for **both customers and internal stakeholders**, while setting the stage for the future success of the SEO team.

By **developing long-form articles, landing pages, and micro-copy** tailored for our supplement portfolio, you will help **drive qualified traffic and leads**, **enhance our brand authority**, and **support customers** on their wellness journey.

## **Essential Roles and Responsibilities**

If you live and breathe keyword research, write SEO content, and geek out over analytics dashboards, this is your arena.

- **Build the content engine** that **drives qualified organic traffic and subscription revenue** for our supplement portfolio.

- **Partner with our Marketing Operations (Men's & Women's) teams** to publish clinically sound, conversion-oriented copy in flawless English.

- **Own the end-to-end SEO content workflow** — from ideation and brief to on-page optimization, launch, and post-publish CRO testing.

## **Skills and Qualifications**

- **Essential Requirements:**

**Experience:** ≥ 2 years writing SEO copy for health, wellness, or medical brands with demonstrable ranking wins.

- **English Proficiency:** IELTS 6.5 + / TOEFL iBT 90 + (or equivalent). Clear, concise, and persuasive writing is a must.

- **Tool Stack:** Ahrefs or SEMrush, WordPress (or similar CMS), Grammarly or Hemingway.

- **Data-driven mindset**, exceptional **research skills**, and laser-sharp** attention to detail**.

- **Nice to have:**

**Tool Stack:** Google Search Console, basic HTML, GA4, SurferSEO or Frase

- **Solid grasp** of **E-E-A-T**, YMYL requirements, and FDA/FTC content compliance.

- Bonus points for **short-form scriptwriting**, **CRO knowledge**, or experience collaborating with medical reviewers.

## **Come join PATI, you will have a chance to enjoy**

- **Compensation:** 11,000,000 – 17,500,000 VND/month + performance incentives tied to organic revenue growth.

- **Professional Development:** Quarterly up-skilling budget, direct mentorship from a 7-figure SEO lead, and access to expert medical advisors.

- **Workplace Culture:** Fast-paced, data-obsessed team that values innovation, wellness, and radical ownership.

- **Benefits:** Social insurance, statutory leave, wellness stipend, regular team-building retreats.

We are looking for someone who shares our passion for wellness, our commitment to excellence, and our dedication to making a positive impact on our customers' lives. If you believe you have the skills and mindset to thrive in this role, we want to hear from you.

## **General Information**

- **Department:** SEO Team (new team)

- **Employee Type: **Full-time, On-site

- **Report directly to:** CEO

- **Working Hours:**

Monday - Friday: 8:30 AM - 5:30 PM, with 1-hour lunch break.

- Saturday (Culture Day): 6:30 AM - 09:00 AM. We kick off Saturdays with team runs and weekly reflections - mind, body, and momentum aligned.

- **Working Location:** 18 Street No. 38, An Khanh Ward, Thu Duc, Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam.
